content: Cloudflare free tier includes: WAF with 5 custom firewall rules, Bot Fight Mode, and rate limiting (1 free rule, since Oct 2022 rate limiting itself is free across all plans though rule count is capped). These apply to tunnel-routed hostnames the same as any proxied DNS record — traffic hits Cloudflare edge/WAF/Bot Fight Mode first and only reaches cloudflared if it passes. Free tier lacks: managed rulesets (OWASP core ruleset), ML anomaly detection, IP lists beyond 10 entries, multi-condition rate limiting. For a single-user hobby app, 1 rate-limit rule (e.g. limit /login attempts) + Bot Fight Mode + 5 custom WAF rules is generally sufficient.
